tickets.title: Core Math, 3D Orientation & Common Mod Traits
tickets.description: Implement 3D rotation matrix and quaternion orientation math supporting all 24 block orientations, along with fundamental RedPower 2 traits and network packet abstractions: IConnectable, ICoverable, IMultipart, IRotatable, IPaintable, IFrameSupport, IPipeConnectable, ITubeConnectable, and description/GUI packet handlers. Done: unit tests for orientation matrix/quaternion transformations and trait contracts pass cleanly.

tickets.title: Core Multipart, Extended Blocks & Appliance Base
tickets.description: Implement BlockExtended, BlockMultipart, BlockCoverable, and TileAppliance base abstractions. Handles sub-tile metadata dispatch, raytraced multipart bounding boxes, player partial harvesting, and frame movement support (IFrameSupport). Done: unit tests for multi-bounding-box raytracing, sub-tile metadata mapping, and block break behaviors pass.

tickets.title: RedPower Redstone Rules & Wire Network Search
tickets.description: Implement RedPowerLib and PowerLib redstone connectivity logic: wire attachment surface rules, corner connection queries across block boundaries, local-to-connection side bitmask transformations, and recursive wire cluster signal strength propagation. Done: unit tests validating wire connection bitmasks, 6-face mapping, and signal level propagation pass.

tickets.title: Blutricity Dynamic RLC Circuit Simulation Engine
tickets.description: Implement the complete RedPower 2 Blutricity physical model (BluePowerConductor and BluePowerEndpoint): 100.0V nominal, 60.0V minimum machine threshold, 120.0V safe operating limit, R=0.01 ohm conductor resistance, inductive scaling step factor 0.07, parallel conductance 0.5, capacitance (endpoint 4.0F, panel 0.25F), and NBT charge persistence. Done: unit tests validating exact dynamic current iteration step, voltage calculation, parallel flow, and endpoint charge storage pass.

tickets.title: Machine Inventory Access & FilterMap Logistics
tickets.description: Implement MachineLib automated inventory handling: sided inventory access extraction and insertion, item stack equality and damage comparison, item ejection, and FilterMap pattern matching and counting algorithms for logistics sorting machines. Done: unit tests for sided inventory filtering, item matching, and stack collection pass.

tickets.title: Fluid Buffer & Pipe Transfer Framework
tickets.description: Implement FluidBuffer, FluidClass, FluidClassBase, and PipeLib: fluid pipe connection testing, liquid registration by block ID and fluid ID, pressure-driven liquid movement between adjacent IPipeConnectable buffers, and NBT/packet synchronization. Done: unit tests for fluid buffer level conservation, pressure leveling, and pipe connectivity pass.

tickets.title: Automation Framework: Frame Solver, Redbus & Disk Helpers
tickets.description: Implement FrameLib::FrameSolver structural movement linkage graph solver (IFrameLink traversal), RedbusLib 8-bit bus addressing and ribbon pathfinding, and DiskLib serial number generation and disk directory resolution. Done: unit tests for frame structure linkage resolution, redbus address query, and disk serial generation pass.

tickets.title: Metallurgy & Base Resource Items (Ingots, Gems, Alloys, Lumars, Nuggets)
tickets.description: Implement all RedPower Base metal ingots, gems, alloys, doped wafers, silicon boules, coils, motors, nuggets, and 16-color Lumars. Configures item registration, max stack size (64), sprites from eloraam/base/items1.png, and contract definitions. Done: make contract-check clean for all 24 resource items; their scenarios pass.

tickets.title: Alloy Metallurgy Recipe System & Remainder Handling
tickets.description: Implement CraftLib alloy recipe registry ('redpower_2:alloy_furnace'): 3x3 unordered ingredient count matching, partial consumption, damage-on-craft tool tracking, and recipes for Red Alloy Ingot, Blue Alloy Ingot, Brass Ingot, Silicon Boule, Red/Blue Doped Wafers, and metal recycling. Done: unit tests for alloy recipe matching, ingredient subtraction, and craft remainder handling pass.

tickets.title: Alloy Furnace: Block, Tile Entity, Container & GUI
tickets.description: Implement Alloy Furnace block, tile entity, container, and GUI: 11 slots (0..8 alloy input matrix, 9 solid fuel, 10 output), 200 tick cook time, solid fuel burn times, sided inventory access (top = inputs, front = fuel, bottom/sides = output), front active fire texture change, and chunk reload persistence. Done: make contract-check clean for alloy_furnace; its level 1, 3, 5 and 6 scenarios pass.

tickets.title: Project Table: Block, Tile Entity, Container & GUI
tickets.description: Implement Project Table block, tile entity, container, and GUI: 28 slots (0..8 persistent 3x3 crafting matrix, 9 plan slot, 10..27 18 internal storage slots), automatic grid refill from storage on craft completion, recipe persistence across GUI closes, sided access to storage slots, and chunk reload persistence. Done: make contract-check clean for project_table; its level 1, 3, 5 and 6 scenarios pass.

tickets.title: Crafting Tools: Handsaws, Screwdriver, Diamond Drawplate & Indigo Dye
tickets.description: Implement core RedPower crafting tools: Iron Handsaw (durability 320, sharpness 0), Diamond Handsaw (durability 1280, sharpness 2) with damage on craft in microblock cutting; Screwdriver (lossless remainder, right-click rotates blocks, shift+right-click cycles operational modes); Diamond Drawplate (durability 255, draws copper/iron ingots into fine wire); and Indigo Dye (dyes wool and sheep blue, dye crafting combinations). Done: make contract-check clean for all 6 tool items; their level 2 scenarios pass.

tickets.title: Microblock Geometry, Slicing Rules & Placement System
tickets.description: Implement microblock sub-voxel geometric system, slicing recipes, and placement rules: 1/8th thickness hierarchy (cover 1/8 to anticover 7/8), shapes (face plate, hollow face plate, edge strip, corner, post, pillar, column), handsaw cutting recipes (vertical cut halves thickness, horizontal cut slices strips/corners), hollow cover crafting (8 covers around empty center), slice recombination crafting, sub-voxel raytracing placement, face occlusion masking (solid covers block connections, hollow covers permit wire/tube pass-through), BlockMicro and ItemMicro. Done: make contract-check clean for microblock; its level 1, 2, and 4 scenarios pass.
